What do the verification labels mean?

Author-attested: the entrant published the evidence, including any checks they ran themselves.

Evidence reviewed: a named reviewer examined the frozen artifacts; their review is linked.

Third-party reproduced: a declared independent party reran the exact protocol and published its own evidence.

Passing the registry validator checks the record’s consistency. It does not run the controller or prove a world first.

03 / SAME GAME. SAME RULES.

The fine print
is the benchmark.

A chain can look impressive while solving a different problem. The exact model, reset, score, and evaluation procedure travel with every result.

3m

Total chain length
1 kg chain + 1 kg cart

±80N

One cart actuator
17 passive hinges

5s

Continuous upright hold
All angles strictly < 0.15 rad

30s

Complete native episode
Stay inside ±3 m throughout

CANONICAL SEVENTEEN / V1

Start hanging.
Earn the upright.

MuJoCo 3.3.5, binary64, RK4. Four 5 ms substeps per command. Score wrapped cumulative absolute angles after each command: 250 consecutive upright samples at 50 Hz. The live plant gets one initialization.

Pass exact calibration, disjoint noisy development sets of 20 and 100, then freeze. The unchanged release must pass all 141 reserved episodes, including the held-out video.

Native-model planning and full-state feedback are allowed. Wall-clock cost and runtime changes must be disclosed. This is a simulation benchmark.
